hotspots.name: GB Road Area
hotspots.description: High crime rate, poorly lit alleyways, and numerous theft and harassment incidents.

hotspots.name: Paharganj Alleys

hotspots.name: Old Delhi Station West
hotspots.description: Severe crowding, reported chain snatching, and high rate of night-time minor assaults.

hotspots.name: Karol Bagh Market Backlanes

hotspots.name: Connaught Place Inner Circle
hotspots.description: Generally secure, but isolated pedestrian subways at late hours are caution zones.

hotspots.name: India Gate Radial Roads
hotspots.description: Well-guarded tourist spot, caution recommended only in unlit peripheral lawn areas.
